# Handy tips & tricks
![](/images/magic.png){style="width:200px; border-radius:15px; background:white" fig-align="center"}

Welcome to the final part of the workshops, Handy tips & tricks! 
This part will include coding to reinforce what you have learnt up to this point. 
There will also be plenty of new handy <u id='function_tooltip'>__functions__</u> and some more concepts to learn.

## Setup

For this part create a directory called "tips_and_tricks" in your main directory and set it as the working directory. 
Then create a script called "4-Handy_tips.R". 
Remember to use annotations (`#`) and code sections (`####`)!

## Sections

Below is an overview of the contents of this part.

### R conventions
![](/images/nametag.png){style="width:200px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

The first part introduces you to 2 different conventions for R coding:

- [Variable names](tips_tricks/variable_names.qmd): Different styles for naming variables
- [Wide vs Long](/tips_tricks/wide_long.qmd): Whether you prefer having your code over one line (wide) or over multiple lines (long)

### RStudio
![](/images/global.png){style="width:150px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

RStudio has a variety of options and buttons. We'll cover the below topics:

- [Global options](/tips_tricks/global_options.qmd): A quick introduction to the global options allowing customisation of RStudio's appearance and hoe it functions
- [Sweep](/tips_tricks/sweep.qmd): The sweep buttons allow you to clear the text in your console and to clear the variables in your environment

### Multiplication table
![](/images/multiplication.png){style="width:150px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}


We'll create a <u id='data_frame_tooltip'>__data frame__</u> containing a [multiplication table](/tips_tricks/multiplication_table.qmd). This acts as a reminder of various skills and knowledge you have learnt up to this point.

### Tab complete
![](/images/tab.png){style="width:150px; border-radius:5px; background:white; border:10px white solid" fig-align="center"}

It is highly beneficial to use the tab key to [tab complete](/tips_tricks/tab_complete.qmd) your code.
In R this can be used to auto-complete file names/paths, variable names, function names, and the options of functions.

### Example datasets
![](/images/tea.png){style="width:150px; background:white; border-radius:5px" fig-align="center"}

This part looks at 2 different example <u id='data_frame_tooltip'>__data frames__</u> to learn some new skills.

- [Tea](/tips_tricks/tea.qmd): A dataset of the annual consumption of tea per capita
  - This will introduce the `gsub()` <u id='function_tooltip'>__function__</u> to substitute strings
- [English speakers across the world](/tips_tricks/english_speakers.qmd): A dataset showing the number of English speakers in countries
  - This will include how you can deal with missing data by replacing NAs and removing unwanted rows

### Identical & shortcuts
![](/images/identikeys.png){style="width:150px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

The next 2 pages are:

[Identical](/tips_tricks/identical.qmd): The `identical()` <u id='function_tooltip'>__function__</u> indicates whether 2 objects are identical
[Shortcuts](/tips_tricks/shortcuts.qmd): An introduction to keyboard shortcuts you can use in RStudio

### Recap & exercises
![](/images/question_bubble_blue.png){style="width:150px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

At the end of the course you'll reinforce the skills and knowledge you have learnt with:

- [Recap MCQs](/tips_tricks/mcqs.qmd): Multiple choice questions to act as a recap of this part
- [Exercises](/tips_tricks/handy_exercises.qmd): Two exercises using the [tea](/tips_tricks/tea_exercise.qmd) & [english speakers across the world](/tips_tricks/english_exercise.qmd) datasets
  - There is also one additional [extra exercise](/tips_tricks/extra_exercise.qmd)
